# Freeborn Ministries International

> Official digital home of Freeborn Ministries International and The Venerable Freeborn A. Onokpite (JP), anchored in Word, Prayer & Deliverance within the Anglican Diocese of Ughelli, Delta State, Nigeria.

## Core Information
- **Leader:** The Venerable Freeborn A. Onokpite (State Deputy Coordinator on Religious Matters, Delta State).
- **Location:** All Saints' Anglican Chapel, DSC Township, Ughelli / Warri, Delta State, Nigeria.
- **Mission:** Transforming lives through the Word of God, prayer, and deliverance.
